text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen, Seiun Sky seems to have slept poorly because of her nerves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The favorites to win are Special Week, who dreams of being the best in Japan, and Grass Wonder, who is well on her way to becoming the greatest of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's not to mention King Halo, who has returned after embarking on her own path. With such a powerful lineup of rivals, we can't afford to give any slack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every trick in the book will be needed—it's the only way we'll win.
